changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant task descriptions into 'Other: Mathematical Reasoning'. Removed dataset variants (MATH500, Omni-MATH-500) as they are subsets of the main datasets. Normalized dataset name capitalization and consolidated output descriptions.

Metrics are correctly extracted and normalized. PassRate measures the ability to generate at least one correct answer among all generated solutions; Accuracy measures correctness of greedy-decoded outputs.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used; the paper relies on rule-based correctness evaluation (final answer matching) and PassRate calculations.
No human evaluation is conducted; all evaluation is automated using rule-based correctness checks.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on reinforcement learning with tree search for improving LLM reasoning capabilities in mathematical and code generation tasks. Evaluation is entirely automated using rule-based correctness metrics (PassRate and Accuracy). The extraction was generally accurate but had some redundancy in task naming and included dataset subsets that weren't necessary.
